pantry.fishSauceGradeTitle: What does the degree label (35°N / 40°N / 60°N) mean on Fish Sauce?
pantry.fishSauceGradeDesc: °N indicates grams of natural nitrogen (protein) per liter. Use 30°N for general cooking and broths; for dipping sauces and fresh rolls, strictly use 40°N single-press fish sauce (like Phú Quốc) for smooth sweetness without harsh salinity.
